name: STAR Numerics — Chebyshev series with derivative
summary: Value and first derivative of a Chebyshev series by Clenshaw's recurrence, on [-1, 1] or on an interval given by midpoint and radius (the convention of ephemeris segments); 600 series agree with CSPICE chbval/chbder and NumPy within 1e-14 and with mpmath at 40 digits within 5e-14 of the natural scale of the sum; reproduces the NAIF documentation example.
reference: NAIF CSPICE documentation of chbval_c and chbder_c: coefficients (1, 3, 0.5, 1, 0.5, -1, 1), midpoint 0.5, radius 3, t = 1: value -0.340878, derivative 0.382716

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: coefficients c_0 first; interval as midpoint and radius; derivative with respect to t
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input; a point outside the interval is refused, never extrapolated; the limits make overflow impossible; the conditioning of cancelling sums is stated as not bounded
